discourse.title: Soham - The Right Sadhana
discourse.excerpt: What is the meaning of Easwarathwa (Divinity)? It can be understood as the Divine, auspicious breath of soham that emanates from a human being. Soham means "I am that" (Divinity). The sound of the breath in human being, i.e. soham establishes the nature of Divinity.
discourse.theme: Every breath chants "Soham — I am That."

reflection: Did you know your breath is already praying? With every breath in — So — and every breath out — Ham — you are declaring "I am That." Twenty-one thousand six hundred times a day, without your permission. Today, just notice it once or twice. That noticing is the right sadhana.

seva_nudge: Teach one person — a child, a friend — to watch their breath for one quiet minute.
